member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.PatientId
member.summary: Gets or sets the document's patient ID1.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.BinaryContent
member.summary: Gets or sets the binary contents of this document.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.FileFormat
member.summary: Gets or sets the file format of this document. The default value is based on the extension of the file path given in the constructor.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.DateOfService
member.summary: Gets or sets the date/time when the service that this document describes was provided. The default value is approximately the current date/time.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.DocumentType
member.summary: Gets or sets the type of this document (e.g., "Special Medical Physics Consultation")

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.AuthoredByUserId
member.summary: Gets or sets the user ID of the author of this document. The default value is the user ID given in the constructor.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.EnteredByUserId
member.summary: Gets or sets the user ID of the person who entered this document into the system. The default value is the user ID given in the constructor.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.DateEntered
member.summary: Gets or sets the date/time when this document was entered into the system. The default value is approximately the current date/time.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.SupervisedByUserId
member.summary: Gets or sets the user ID of the supervisor of this document.
member.remarks: According the the Varian Oncology Services Reference Guide, this is the person who will eventually approve this document. The default value is the user ID given in the constructor.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.SignedByUserId
member.summary: Gets or sets the user ID of the person who signed this document. The default value is null.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.DateSigned
member.summary: Gets or sets the date/time when this document was signed. The default value is null.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.ApprovedByUserId
member.summary: Gets or sets the user ID of the person who approved this document. The default value is null.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.DateApproved
member.summary: Gets or sets the date/time when this document was approved. The default value is null.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.IsMarkedAsError
member.summary: Gets or sets whether to mark this document as an error. The default value is false.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.TemplateName
member.summary: Gets or sets the "secondary type" (Varian terminology) of this document. The default value is null.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.IsCompleted
member.summary: Gets or sets whether to mark this document as completed. The default value is false.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.PreviewText
member.summary: Gets or sets the preview text associated with this document. The default value is null.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.PatientFirstName
member.summary: Gets or sets the first name of this document's patient. If set, it must match the data from the PatientId. The default value is null.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.PatientLastName
member.summary: Gets or sets the last name of this document's patient. If set, it must match the data from the PatientId. The default value is null.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.DescriptionOfImage
member.summary: Gets or sets the description of the image, if this document is an image The default value is null.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.IsPreApproved
member.summary: Gets or sets whether this document was pre-approved when entering the system. The default value is false.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.IsPrivate
member.summary: Gets or sets whether this document is private. The default value is false.

member.name: P:UMRO.Aria.Documents.Document.IsSystemGen
member.summary: Gets or sets whether this document was generated by the system. The default value is false.
